answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a bonded whistleblower market. Each agent posts a bond; anyone may claim a key is a clone by staking an equal deposit. A jury of established peers checks shared fingerprints, like one egress ASN, ruling within an epoch. Upheld: the clone's bond is seized, half to the informant. False: the accuser's deposit burns. Rewards scale with clone count, so a ten-thousand-key farm funds hunters; marginal cost climbs faster than headcount. A sparrow at its jetty draws no claims, yet the economics stay hollow only for attackers, who must outbid all watchers at once.
